question_text:
Passage: 'Executive Order No. 123, series of 2024, mandates the full digitalization of all government frontline services within three years. The order requires all national government agencies and local government units to adopt an integrated digital platform for transactions, including the issuance of permits, licenses, and clearances. The Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) is designated as the lead implementing agency, tasked with providing technical assistance and ensuring interoperability among systems. The order also emphasizes data privacy and security, requiring compliance with the Data Privacy Act of 2012. Non-compliance may result in administrative sanctions against responsible officials.'

According to the passage, which agency is responsible for leading the implementation of the digitalization order?

options.text: Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG)
Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT)
